title: Lumbermark: Resistant Clustering by Chopping Up Mutual Reachability Minimum Spanning Trees
abstract: arXiv:2604.07143v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce Lumbermark, a robust divisive clustering algorithm capable of detecting clusters of varying sizes, densities, and shapes. Lumbermark iteratively chops off large limbs connected by protruding segments of a dataset's mutual reachability minimum spanning tree. The use of mutual reachability distances smoothens the data distribution and decreases the influence of low-density objects, such as noise points between clusters or outliers at their peripheries. The algorithm can be viewed as a divisive version of Genie and an alternative to HDBSCAN that produces partitions with user-specified sizes. A fast, easy-to-use implementation of this new method is available in the open-source lumbermark package for Python and R. We show that Lumbermark performs well on benchmark data and hope it will prove useful to data scientists and practitioners across different fields.

translated_title: Lumbermark：通过切分互达性最小生成树实现的抗噪声聚类算法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Lumbermark，一种稳健的分裂式聚类算法，能够检测不同大小、密度和形状的聚类。Lumbermark通过迭代地切掉数据集互达性最小生成树上由突出片段连接的大枝干来进行聚类。互达性距离的使用平滑了数据分布，降低了低密度对象（如聚类之间的噪声点或聚类边缘的离群点）的影响。该算法可被视为Genie的分裂式版本，也是HDBSCAN的替代方案，能够生成用户指定大小的分区。这种新方法的快速、易用的实现已在开源的Python和R软件包lumbermark中提供。我们展示了Lumbermark在基准数据上的良好表现，并希望它能对不同领域的数据科学家和从业者有所帮助。
tldr: 提出了Lumbermark，一种通过迭代切分互达性最小生成树来检测不同大小、密度和形状聚类的稳健分裂式聚类算法，可作为HDBSCAN的替代方案并支持生成用户指定大小的分区。
en_tdlr: Lumbermark is a robust divisive clustering algorithm that iteratively chops up mutual reachability minimum spanning trees to detect clusters of varying sizes, densities, and shapes, serving as an HDBSCAN alternative that produces partitions with user-specified sizes.
